notes: |-

  Sources: https://www.rcsb.org/structure/1BNA ; https://doi.org/10.1073/pnas.78.4.2179 . Coordinate file, measurements and method: ../assets/science/. Preserve the image pixels, exact twelve chart values, axes/units, chain identity and this qualification when editing wording.
